description: Poll a crawl job for progress and the pages crawled so far. Polls are incremental: pass the previous response's `nextCursor` as `since` to receive only the pages crawled since your last poll. Pages omit their content by default — set include_content true only when you actually need the text (a large crawl's full content can be hundreds of KB).

include_content.description: Include each page's full content (default false — metadata only)

jobId.description: The crawl job id returned by crawl

since.description: Page cursor from the previous poll's `nextCursor` — returns only newer pages

name: crawl_status
